newsitem.title: USA: Streisand won't sing at Oscars, rumours of snub.
newsitem.headline: Streisand won't sing at Oscars, rumours of snub.

text.p: Barbra Streisand will not be singing her Oscar-nominated song at the Academy Awards show, and officials said on Friday they were unaware if the star had snubbed the event because her movie was not nominated.

"We don't know anything about a snub," a spokeswoman for the Academy of Motion Picture Arts and Sciences said. "All we know is that Natalie Cole will be singing (Streisand's song "I Finally Found Someone").

The spokeswoman said Streisand gave no reason for not singing at Monday's show, although she had originally intended to perform. "She doesn't want to sing and I don't expect her to attend," she said, adding that all Oscar nominees were invited to the awards ceremony.
Local news reports have said Streisand was upset that her film, "The Mirror Has Two Faces", which she directed and co-produced, was passed over for a best picture nod.
There was no immediate comment from her publicist or the Oscar show producer on whether she had snubbed the Academy.
In contrast, Madonna, who was also passed over for an Oscar nomination, will be at the Shrine Auditorium on Monday singing one of the other nominated songs, "You Must Love Me", from her film "Evita".
Madonna won the Golden Globe award as best actress in a musical or comedy for her role as Argentina's Eva Peron, and had predicted she would be nominated for an Oscar.
In addition to the song from "The Mirror Has Two Faces," Lauren Bacall has been nominated as best supporting actress for the movie, in which she played Streisand's mother.
The song, "I Finally Found Someone," was written by Streisand, Marvin Hamlisch, Bryan Adams and Robert Lange.

The other three songs nominated are: "Because You Loved Me" from "Up Close and Personal", which will be performed on Monday by Celine Dion; "For the First Time" from "One Fine Day", to be sung by Kenny Loggins; and "That Thing You Do!" from the film of the same name. The Academy did not know Friday who would be performing that song.
